# Tennis Buddee

> A smart tennis racket that feels every shot. A sensor insert in the handle (ESP32-C3, LSM6DSV320X IMU with a
> ±320 g accelerometer, INMP441 microphone) detects each hit and computes swing speed, ball speed, spin, face angle,
> stroke type and contact point on the racket itself. iPhone, Mac, Apple Watch and Meta Ray-Ban Display show it live.
> Meta's open Muse Spark (`meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026`, served by Baseten) runs as a tool-calling agent over the player's own data and calls a physics
> simulator to predict what a swing change would do. Built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 to
> Nov 2, 2026. MIT licensed.

Key facts:

- Category: smart sports device (instrumented racket + apps). Muse predicts outcomes of swing changes with a
  physics simulator on the player's own shots; every number it reports must come from a tool result.
- Meta Muse Spark: 10 native function-calling tools (query_shots, compare_sessions, get_session_digest,
  get_live_state, simulate_change, list_shots, read_live_sensors, get_racket_status, recall_notes, remember_note),
  called through a Supabase edge function that holds the API key. Bounded loop: 5 requests, 8 tool calls per round, 45 s.
- Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit (MWDATCore, MWDATDisplay): live HUD on Meta Ray-Ban Display.
- Meta SAM 3.1 (video + image APIs): racket tracking and contact-label pre-fill behind the reviewed contacts;
  cached observations feed the stroke baseline and the web emulator.
- Firmware 1.6 computes each shot on the racket (C++ port of the Swift `ShotAnalyzer`, parity-tested), sends an 80-byte
  summary, then the raw 448-sample window with acks, resends and a flash backlog.
- Evidence: 106 Swift test methods, 150 Python test cases, a passing backend suite, a firmware host test,
  C++/Python ML parity on 296 clips, an 86-minute real club session report, and honest model results
  (67.2% sweet-spot accuracy vs a 60.6% baseline).

## Repo map

- [Apps + agent + glasses](apple/): iPhone/Mac/Watch apps, `RacketKit` Swift package
- [Firmware](firmware/): ESP32-C3 PlatformIO project
- [ML](ml/): audio model, dataset generator, run reports
- [Backend](backend/): Supabase schema + `muse` edge function
- [Tools](tools/): recording, labeling, checking, agent-eval scripts
- [Robot rig](TennisRobot/): camera + arm ground-truth framework
- [Demo video source](video/): Remotion project ([shoot plan](video/SHOOT_PLAN.md), [on-screen copy](video/src/config/copy.ts))
- [Docs](docs/): wiring, privacy, TestFlight, plans

Skip (large local-only or generated output): `data/external/`, `data/Tennis Camera/`, `*.tbrec`,
`marketing/*.mp4`, `video/out/`, `apple/.build/`, `firmware/.pio/`, `backend/supabase/node_modules/`.
